chunks: And ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who prays while wearing an iron ring, he said: “No, and he should not wear it, because it is from the attire of the people of the Fire.”
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray while wearing an iron ring in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning praying while wearing an iron ring and also discourages wearing it generally. The Imam عليه السلام states that it is not to be worn, linking it to the attire of the people of the Fire, which underscores its reprehensibility.
